question: Who among the following cabinet ministers was appointed as the Governor of Karnataka in July 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Thawarchand Gehlot.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Thawarchand Gehlot is an Indian politician from the Bharatiya Janata Party **(BJP)**.
 
• He was appointed as the Governor of Karnataka in **July 2021.**
 
• He is **currently serving as ****Governor of Karnataka**.
 
• Prior to that, he was the Minister of Social Justice and Empowerment in the Government of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In July 2021,** Hari Babu Kambhampati **was serving as the Governor of Mizoram. He is **currently serving as Governor of Mizoram**.
 
• In July 2021, **Rajendra Vishwanathan **was the Governor of the Indian state of Sikkim. Rajendra Vishwanath is **currently serving as the governor of the state of Arunachal Pradesh.**
 
• In July 2021, Arjun Munda was serving as the Minister of Tribal Affairs in the Government of India. **Currently, the Minister of Tribal Affairs is Shri Jual Oram**.
